verdict.rationale: Kong's Dev Portal lets you publish APIs from OpenAPI or AsyncAPI specs plus Markdown docs. Developers can browse and search the docs, try operations, and manage their own credentials, and the portal supports private, authenticated visibility for internal audiences. Catalog adds a platform-level inventory of APIs, API packages, AI models and MCP servers, so teams can find what already exists without checking each team's tools. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the portal and catalog workflow (all evidence is vendor documentation).
